conviction_note: The quarter is already out: a non-consolidated flash on 10-06, after which the stock fell 6.3%, and a Nikkei report on 10-19 putting H1 operating profit near 110bn against a 104.9bn plan. So the print turns on DISCO's one-quarter-ahead Oct-Dec guide. The pull is two-sided. IFIS implies a Q3 bar of about 69bn ordinary profit (+13% QoQ), and DISCO has guided below consensus each time (July: 55.9 vs 60bn+, then -12%). Against that, TSMC's unchanged $60-64bn capex implies a sharp Q4 step-up, and the stock is already 19% off its 10-06 close. The findings net to 0.0 and p_up is 49 on an abs move of 7.5, so the scaled number is -0.15.
bar: IFIS consensus via kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=6146, fetched 2026-10-22): ordinary profit cumulative H1 112,396m, 9M 181,346m, FY 261,009m. That implies Q3 (Oct-Dec) ordinary profit of about 68,950m. The company H1 plan is OP 104,900m / ordinary 104,800m (Q1 短信, https://www.disco.co.jp/jp/ir/library/doc/fr/fr20260723.pdf). This is one estimate source and the page does not date its consensus, so the bar is single-sourced and every size is capped small. print_vs_bar compares the H1 ordinary profit implied by the 観測 (~110bn) with 112.4bn.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 2026-10-21: 0.0%, no position at or above 0.5% and no change (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 11.16: margin longs are crowded, the one setup where a disappointing guide still has sellers. Minkabu retail 'buy forecasts rising' put DISCO 2nd on 10-20 and 5th on 10-21 (kabutan). No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.59, almost all from margin overhang. Tape: run_up_20d +1.26%, but the stock rose from 53,320 to 65,500 into the 10-06 flash and has fallen back to 53,080, which is -19% from the 10-06 close and about -42% from the 91,680 high of 6-23.

findings.finding: IFIS consensus implies Oct-Dec ordinary profit of about 69.0bn: 9M 181.3bn less H1 112.4bn. That is about 13% above the ~61bn Q2 the Nikkei 観測 implies (H1 OP ~110bn less Q1 49.0bn). DISCO's July guide for Jul-Sep (OP 55.9bn) came in below a consensus of 60bn+ and the stock fell about 12%, so another conservative guide below this bar is the likeliest shape of the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the one-quarter-ahead guide undershot consensus at the July 2026 print (Jul-Sep OP 55.9bn vs 60bn+), the stock fell about 12% the next session (kabutan/Fisco 2026-07-24; baseline -12.27). When the FY guide came in near consensus at the Jan 2026 print, the stock rose about 17% (kabutan 2026-01-22). The Apr 2026 Q1 guide of +22% YoY drew a flat-to-negative reaction (-3.78). In the baseline, the last two October prints rose: +7.67 in 2024 and +5.03 in 2025.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-22 (fetched; consensus date not shown on the page)
findings.why_not_priced: Only the Oct-Dec guide is new at this print. The conservative-guide habit is well known (Fisco called the July guide 'in line with its conservative tendency'), and since 10-06 the stock has fallen 19%, which may already discount a soft guide. If that were fully priced, the IFIS 9M number would have been cut toward ~175bn. On the page it still implies +13% QoQ.
findings.independence: July reaction article, a different source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202607240555 (guide below 60bn+ consensus, sharp fall). The Q2 base comes from Fisco on the 観測: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202610190340

findings.finding: The Jul-Sep quarter is already out. On 10-06 the non-consolidated flash put H1 sales at 213.6bn against a 201.1bn plan (+6.2%) and Q2 shipments at a record 123.9bn (+60% YoY, +6.4% QoQ); the stock fell 6.3% on 10-07. On 10-19 a Nikkei report put H1 OP near 110bn, about 8bn over the 104.9bn plan, and Fisco called it in line. That leaves the consolidated H1 about 2% under IFIS's 112.4bn ordinary-profit consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pre-released quarters have been sold or ignored: -6.3% on the 10-07 flash, a 'sharp fall' on the 07-07 Q1 flash, 'limited reaction' to the Jan 9 flash, and 'no surprise' on the 07-21 and 10-19 観測 reports (kabutan).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The flash and the 観測 are public and the stock sold both, so this line is filed at 0.
findings.independence: Nikkei 観測 via Fisco: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202610190340. This shares the quarter with finding 1's Q2 base and only sets that base; it is not counted twice.

findings.finding: On 10-15 TSMC, the largest buyer of DISCO's advanced-packaging grinders and dicers, beat its Q3 guide (US$46.7bn) and guided Q4 to $52.3-54.3bn. It held FY2026 capex at $60-64bn after Q3 capex of about $13.8bn, which arithmetically implies a large Q4 step-up. With DISCO's record Q2 shipments and its shipped-but-not-yet-accepted inventory build (Q1 inventory +11.6bn), this argues for a firm Oct-Dec shipment and sales plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean history of DISCO reacting to a customer's capex. On the 2026-10-15 session the Japanese semicap names fell sharply (DISCO -8.5%), so the market did not read the run-up to TSMC's print as positive for DISCO.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is public and DISCO has fallen since. The residual is transmission. The market sees it in DISCO only through DISCO's own shipment plan, which comes out tonight. If it were priced, the stock would not have kept falling after 10-15 while IFIS's Q3 bar stayed +13% QoQ.
findings.independence: Same period, company level: DISCO's non-consolidated Q2 shipments record (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202610070754). The Q4 capex arithmetic is a secondary computation (https://stockhub.kr/en/news/news_b40c7d7eea3f) that I did not confirm in TSMC's own document.

findings.finding: The interim dividend forecast is 171 yen (+42), set against an H1 net profit plan of 73.8bn. With H1 profit running about 5% over plan on the 観測, the interim dividend will likely be raised modestly with the results, as it was at the October 2025 interim print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At FY prints DISCO's dividend increases (+68 yen on the FY2025 year-end, Apr 2026) did not lift the stock (-3.78). Dividend changes are mechanical with profit, and the stock does not react to them separately.
findings.why_not_priced: Barely unpriced: anyone can compute it from the 観測. Its size reflects that.

outside_window.finding: SK hynix (HBM, a major DISCO grinder customer) reports Q3 2026 on 2026-10-27/28. The Hana estimate is OP +29% QoQ. This is after the window.

baseline_tension: The guide-vs-consensus pattern agrees with the -0.59 priced lean from crowded margin longs. Against it stand the -19% drawdown since 10-06, which may already hold a soft guide (悪材料出尽くし), and positive October-print history (+7.7, +5.0). The strongest positive the release could carry is an Oct-Dec guide near the ~69bn bar on TSMC's Q4 capex step-up, plus a nudged interim dividend. I looked for both, filed them, and they offset the negative.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the pre-released quarter finding moved from -0.2 to 0.0, because the flash and the 観測 are public and were sold.

Rule 2 (check the sign): the strongest positive (a firm guide on TSMC's Q4 capex, a dividend nudge) was already looked for and filed. p_up moved 48 to 49, so expected_move_pct went from -0.30 to -0.15.
The guidance finding (-1.0) stayed: it rests on what the release ADDS, not on a visible miss.
